method: Retrieved all comparison pages and every individual commit. Reviewed commit subjects and changed-file lists, then relevant skill/authentication/extension diffs and final source. Historical merge imports were compared against baseline blobs; final skill subtree identities were compared independently. Categories identify review areas, not runtime compatibility verdicts.

tests.note: Default full suite; opt-in contracts also executed separately with SKILLVIEW_CONTRACT_TESTS=true.

limitations: Linux ARM64 checks only; no new Windows/macOS/AOT run.
Expiring credential output tested with source-derived fixtures; actual OAuth credential rotation was not forced.

commands.contracts: PATH=<verified-gh-bin>:$PATH TMPDIR=/var/tmp SKILLVIEW_CONTRACT_TESTS=true dotnet test --project tests/SkillView.Tests/SkillView.Tests.csproj --no-build --no-restore --filter-trait Category=Contract

before.message: Repository suffix cli/cli@v2.103.0 was treated as part of the repository name and produced HTTP 404.

discoveredDefect.regression: Live previews of skills/gh at v2.102.0 and v2.103.0 distinguish content using the refresh_expired marker.

initialCheckCorrections: The first live preview contract expected an auth-login command that is absent from the upstream skill; it was corrected to use the actual refresh_expired content marker.
The extension fixture was corrected to use gh extension install . and the built apphost. The final check verifies GhExtension invocation and the exact GH_PATH.
